vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: salesforce-api
Version: 1.0.7

The Salesforce API skill bundle provides a standard integration for interacting with Salesforce CRM via the Maton.ai proxy service. The documentation in SKILL.md includes proactive safety instructions for the AI agent, such as requiring explicit user confirmation for all write/delete operations and recommending the use of sandbox environments. No evidence of malicious intent, data exfiltration, or unauthorized execution was found; the skill follows standard OAuth and API key management patterns.

llm.summary: This is a disclosed Salesforce integration that can read and change CRM data through Maton, with appropriate user-approval safeguards and no evidence of hidden behavior.

dimensions.detail: The skill supports Salesforce queries, CRUD, composite, and batch operations, including record mutation and deletion; that authority is high impact but directly matches the stated CRM administration purpose and is prominently disclosed.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions tell agents to default to read-only work, verify connection IDs and target records, describe write/delete effects, and wait for explicit user approval before POST, PATCH, DELETE, composite, or batch actions.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifact itself is documentation-only with one SKILL.md and no executable scripts; it instructs users to install the external Maton CLI globally via npm or Homebrew, which is disclosed and purpose-aligned.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Network access, MATON_API_KEY, Salesforce OAuth, and proxying through api.maton.ai are necessary for the integration and disclosed, though users should avoid printing or sharing the API key.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Salesforce OAuth connections can remain active through Maton until revoked or deleted; the skill documents listing, selecting, deleting, and revoking unused connections.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install this only if you need Salesforce CRM administration through Maton. Use the narrowest Salesforce permissions available, prefer sandbox orgs for destructive or batch work, verify the exact connection, sObject, and record IDs before approving writes or deletes, and revoke unused Maton/Salesforce connections.
llm.findings:
[SkillSpector clean report] expected: SkillSpector reported no issues; this matches the inspected artifact, which is a single non-executable Markdown skill with disclosed Salesforce access.
[Static scan clean] expected: Static scan reported no findings, and local inspection found no bundled scripts, hidden files, obfuscation, or automatic execution paths.
[VirusTotal clean telemetry] expected: VirusTotal reported no detections and described the OAuth/API-key behavior as standard; this is consistent with the artifact but was not used as the sole basis for the verdict.
